notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Deadpool after it enters.
description:
Cast Deadpool by paying {2}{B}{R}. As Deadpool enters, have its text box be swapped with Enduring Courage's text box.
Kill Deadpool by any method. When Deadpool dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a noncreature enchantment. As Deadpool enters, have its text box be swapped with Devoted Druid's text box.
Activate Deadpool by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Deadpool by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.
